newsitem.title: USA: Dover sees California buy adding to 97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Dover sees California buy adding to 97 EPS.

text.p: Dover Corp said on Monday that it has acquired Everett Charles Technologies, a California-based company involved in circuit board testing, for undisclosed terms.
Dover said the acquisition will not affect its 1996 earnings per share, "but should add about $0.02 per share to 1997 and more in the years beyond."
The company declined to comment further about 1997 earnings projections.
Dover said Everett Charles will operate as a separate company within its Dover Technologies International subsidiary.
In a release, the company said Everett Charles "is a very strong company with good internal growth opportunities and potential as a base for further related acquisitions."
